status: Freeze step F4 (SPEC_V3.md section 8), committed after the score freeze F3 (configs_v3/freeze_f3.json) and before any held-out device was converted, scored or simulated. Seen beforehand: what SPEC_V3.md section 1 lists. The held-out devices are converted only after Khaled's review of SPEC_V3.md; any change that review makes to this file is committed before the conversion and recorded in DECISIONS_V3.md. Every run of this config uses nac_bench.run_v3 at a clean commit that contains this file.

settings.readout: each qubit's reset flip probability equals its readout flip probability (P1-13, the headline setting)
settings.zero: reset flip probability 0 on every qubit, as in the converted snapshots (the bridge to v1 and v2)

circuit_note: Native CZ circuits (R3-C2, R3-S4); the surface code is the rotated Z-memory with both hook-safe schedules as candidates
seed_note: New and disjoint from every v1 (20261011-13), v2 (20261021-23, 20261031) and v3 Phase 1 (20261108-10) seed. Main-stage chunk k of a placement on base seed b: derive_seed('eval-v3-held-out', b, case_id, key, k); pilot: derive_seed('pilot-v3-held-out', pilot_seed, case_id, key, k); the R3-C5 random sample and the Nove checks: seeds derived from sample_seed and the case id ('sample-v3-held-out', 'check-v3-held-out')

shots_rule.description: R3-C6: every simulated placement gets one 100,000-shot pilot on the pilot seed; its main-stage shots per seed are the smallest 200,000 x 2^k with 3 x shots x p >= 400, capped at 25,600,000 (p = 0 gives the cap); only main-stage counts on the three base seeds enter any result

best_found.description: R3-C5, on the square lattice at d=5 and d=7: every method's choice, the top 30 by the decoder-graph score, summed error and mapomatic's cost, and 100 uniform placements; every placement elsewhere

verdict_rule: P1-1: better when the upper end of the 95% Newcombe interval for P_L(choice) - P_L(reference) is below zero, worse when its lower end is above zero, otherwise tie; the same placement is a tie
test: two-sided pooled two-proportion z-test on the main-stage failure counts pooled over the three base seeds; Holm's step-down correction over the family

claim_rules.description: Per layout and reference: 'beats' when better after Holm in at least 5 of the layout's 8 repetition cases and worse after Holm in none; 'loses to' when worse after Holm in at least one (each named); otherwise 'no difference shown'. Surface code, per device and reference: 'beats' / 'loses to' when better / worse after Holm, otherwise 'no difference shown'
